observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" | grep -oE '(alert[^>]*>[^<]*<|Invalid [a-z ]+|errors[^>]*>[^<]*)' | head -8; echo "=== session check: try with email confirmation requirement? ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select email, confirmed_at is not null, verified_at is not null, level_two_verified_at is not null from users where email='admin@consul.dev'"
